observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation console box/cover with a vertical seam; no controller/cables shown.
Photo 1 shows the front/top surface with a PlayStation logo and watermark text; no model label visible.
Photo 2 shows the back/bottom side with several small ports/holes/buttons visible; no HDMI/USB ports clearly shown and no serial/model sticker visible.

claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4
claims.evidence: No PS4 Pro model/label is readable in the provided photos; only a generic console exterior is shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Photos do not show seals, internal condition, or opening history.
No temperature/usage test footage or error logs shown.
No close-up of ports and no functional test shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No accessories/receipt are shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Console model is not confirmed (could be PS4/PS4 Slim/PS4 Pro/other); pricing depends heavily on exact model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model/serial sticker (or the label on the back/underside) showing the exact model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest matching PS4 type in the comparables (worst case: not confirmed as PS4 Pro).

risks.risk: No proof of functionality (ports, HDMI, USB, disc drive, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth) from photos.
risks.proof: Short video showing the console powering on, booting to home screen, and testing at least HDMI + 1 USB port + controller pairing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven/assume issues possible; use the cheapest comparable.

risks.risk: Accessories/receipt claim not shown; 'original pads' may be missing or not original.
risks.proof: Photo of the included pads/accessories laid out, plus a photo of the UK receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming receipt/accessories are included.

risks.risk: Hacked/modified status (common in PS4 listings) can affect reliability and warranty/ban risk; not verifiable from photos.
risks.proof: Photo/video of system settings showing firmware version and whether it boots normally; also show installed games/apps list.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used console with no special guarantees.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console model/serial sticker (back/underside) so we can confirm PS4 Pro vs other PS4.
Video: power on + boot to home screen + show HDMI output working.
Video: test at least one USB port and controller pairing (show controller connected on-screen).
Photos of included items: 'original pads' laid out + UK receipt.
response.reason: The photos do not clearly identify the exact PlayStation model (needed to price correctly) and there is no functional testing or accessory/receipt proof. Without the model label and a quick boot/port test, any price would be guesswork.
